candidates.angle: lines / user topic: defineFauxCopy panics in every build
candidates.summary: A blank type switch variable (`switch _ := x.(type)`) never gets a slot, since Reserve returns on `_`, but defineSwitchVar still calls defineFauxCopy(numFauxCopiedNames(), "_"), which now panics in every build
candidates.failure_scenario: Filetest `var i any = 42; switch _ := i.(type) { case int: x := 3; println(x) }`: Reserve skips `_` (nodes.go:2309), so slot numFauxCopiedNames() holds `x`; defineSwitchVar (preprocess.go:1056) hits the now-unconditional check and preprocess fails with `faux copy slot 0 holds x, not _`; a bodyless clause fails with index out of range. The base wrote by name (Define2 ignores `_`) and ran the version with a body. Go and gno's typecheck both reject the source (`no new variables on left side of :=`, confirmed with gno run), so no deployable or node-boot source reaches it. Only the filetest runner, which preprocesses despite a TypeCheckError (redefine6.gno), and untypechecked paths show an internal error in place of the Go diagnostic. The ADR sentence 'the variable is reserved at exactly numFauxCopiedNames()' does not hold for `_`.
candidates.verify_by: Add tests/solo-finder-blank-tsvar.gno as gnovm/tests/files/blank_tsvar.gno and run `go test ./gnovm/pkg/gnolang -run TestFiles/blank_tsvar.gno`: expect the Error `faux copy slot 0 holds x, not _` at head. Fix shape: skip defineSwitchVar when ss.VarName == blankIdentifier, or reject it in preprocess with Go's message
candidates.evidence: Read: nodes.go:2309 `if nx.Name == blankIdentifier { return }`; preprocess.go:1056-1057 `csb.defineFauxCopy(csb.numFauxCopiedNames(), ss.VarName, anyValue(t))` guarded only by `ss.VarName != ""`; base preprocess.go:1069 used last.Define by name. gno run at head stops at typecheck: `blank2.gno:5:9: no new variables on left side of :=`.
